method: Read-only synthesis of frozen-source checklist, persisted candidate CFG/annotation, propagation records, independent source-boundary/loop evidence and independent DOE/review evidence. JSON/text and Python standard library only; no production import, target execution, model, replay, test, active-run inspection or original-artifact modification. This is an assistant source audit, not human gold.
classification_scope: Each row assesses its stated source relation. Supported means the identified finite relation is evidenced with the stated limits; mixed means material support coexists with a gap or narrower contradiction; contradicted identifies a concrete represented relation inconsistent with source; unresolved includes absent central relationships. No percentages or general accuracy score are inferred.

count_boundaries.warning: Source-site counts, shared operation coordinates, finite Data alternatives and correctness criteria are different populations; none is an observed runtime-call count or semantic-accuracy denominator.

criteria.expected_relation: Preserve analyze, saved JSON read and markdown summary write. A specific returned save filepath can identify a write; list/latest examples select stored files and do not themselves prove membership in the current analysis.
candidate_evidence: Analysis, save, list/latest and load capabilities are represented separately; this does not establish a single analysis-to-summary workflow.
computed_evidence: Primary API/save boundaries have persisted Data alternatives. No implemented current-analysis-to-corresponding-file association, summary consumer, tables/trends/recommendations or Markdown write is supplied; R08 has zero goals.
counterevidence_or_limit: The central declared summary continuation is absent/unresolved. A category, timestamp, control order or standalone load does not identify the current saved response.

criteria.expected_relation: Keep module import and dotenv config side effect distinct. Both index and direct API imports can reach settings through imports; neither calls every exported API function merely by loading the module.
candidate_evidence: Module loading and settings initialization are distinct from selected public invocations; ir_011 explicitly calls dotenv, reads and writes the actual environment poststate and updates lifecycle state.
Direct-entry help is guarded by ir_017; ir_018 emits static help. Reexports do not encode invocation of every exported function.
computed_evidence: The selected import/initialization/help IR are processed. Dotenv configuration and environment poststate remain distinct Data steps, rather than treating configuration as a no-op.
counterevidence_or_limit: This supports the inspected import/initialization distinction, not the unspecified internals of dotenv or all concrete module-loader executions.

criteria.expected_relation: Retain declared .env creation and installation as workflow side effects, then environment values including private key newline normalization, service account email, property, site and date default. The credentials in SKILL are examples/placeholders, not actual secrets.
candidate_evidence: Setup contains shell cd at ir_003 and npm installation at ir_005. ir_011 represents dotenv configuration; ir_365 reads environment/runtime and computes settings with labels for private key, email, property, site and local directory.
computed_evidence: Installation and runtime environment/settings paths have saved records. No represented .env creation write was found in these setup paths; represented persistent writes target saved result storage.
counterevidence_or_limit: The declared .env creation obligation is absent/unresolved, not established by dotenv reading or an environment poststate. Newline conversion, missing-value defaults and results-directory selection are opaque computation/gap detail; examples are not actual secret values.

criteria.expected_relation: Validation checks presence and names missing settings. Constructors consume client_email/private_key and auth scopes, with opaque SDK internal behavior. Both webmasters.readonly and indexing scopes enter the shared GoogleAuth constructor.
candidate_evidence: ir_359 labels credential validation as configuration-presence information; ir_361 constructs its error. ir_363 explicitly selects email/privateKey, builds constructor inputs and includes both webmasters.readonly and indexing scopes for GoogleAuth.
computed_evidence: Constructor calls and separate cache writes are present in processed ir_363. These are credential-derived handles; the representation does not establish private-key plaintext in subsequent remote API payloads.
counterevidence_or_limit: Exact visible validation logic and missing-name error construction remain opaque; caller-local getter provenance is not restored by a separate standalone constructor entry. SDK internals remain unknown.

criteria.expected_relation: Three independently cached clients return existing handles on cache hits; otherwise validate, construct and assign. Preserve credential provenance at creation and distinguish future reset/creation. Reset does not erase historical calls.
candidate_evidence: The candidate has cached-return, validate/create and reset branches, but cached reads use locations.caches while construction writes use ga_cache, sc_cache and index_cache.
computed_evidence: ir_356/e0 reads runtime_context name core.client.cached_bindings. ir_363/e7, e18 and e29 write clientInstance, searchConsoleClientInstance and indexingClientInstance respectively. Saved changes update those individual names and symbolic:selected-public-invocation, not core.client.cached_bindings.
counterevidence_or_limit: This is a concrete represented state-identity contradiction: the cached read is disconnected from the represented per-client updates. It is not proof that the actual source ignores caches, and it is independent of unknown SDK behavior.

criteria.expected_relation: Only absent/falsy date input reads settings default. Object input is returned directly. Shorthand conversion differs for Search Console ISO dates versus GA4 relative dates; invalid strings fall back to 30 days.
candidate_evidence: The standalone date parser retains a falsy/default branch, direct object return at ir_294, invalid-string 30-day fallback, GA4 relative range at ir_303 and separate Search Console clock acquisitions at ir_305.
computed_evidence: ir_294 has an ordinary CFG return without fabricated processing/model-observation events. ir_288 selects defaultDateRange from settings only on its represented default branch.
counterevidence_or_limit: Caller-local date helpers remain opaque acquisitions. Separate parser entries do not establish caller provenance, exact shorthand parsing or Search Console ISO conversion/clock relationships for every request.

criteria.topic: Standard report request identity and ignored options
criteria.expected_relation: Request contains property/dateRanges/mapped dimension and metric names plus truthy limit. filters and orderBy are documented/destructured but are not placed into the request. Returned first response is unchanged except the TypeScript cast.
candidate_evidence: ir_187 explicitly builds property, dateRanges, dimensions, metrics and conditionally limit. It omits filters and orderBy, preserving the source/documentation discrepancy.
computed_evidence: ir_189 has paired request/response facts; ir_192 saves the corresponding response version and ir_194 returns it. The cast is not represented as a field-narrowing operation.
counterevidence_or_limit: This supports the inspected request field membership and response identity. Name mapping, truthy-limit computation and caller helper internals retain opaque precision; the documented filtering/sorting requirement R13 remains partial, not satisfied.

criteria.expected_relation: Keep four call sites and each dimension/metric pair; retain save flags and original response versions. Live snapshot invokes only three of these helpers.
candidate_evidence: All four realtime source sites are cited by shared ir_196/ir_198. ir_196 computes its request opaquely from entry_name and property; liveSnapshot instead has three separate caller expansions ir_083, ir_085 and ir_087.
computed_evidence: The shared direct-entry ir_198 has exactly one request Data identity and one response Data identity, not four resolved operation-specific pairs. The three liveSnapshot copies have separate pairs and do not introduce a firstUserSource child.
counterevidence_or_limit: The direct-entry distinction required by S08 is collapsed/unestablished: four cited source sites are not four resolved dimension/metric requests or original response versions. The correct three-child liveSnapshot representation does not repair this loss.

criteria.expected_relation: Dimensions-only and metrics-only helpers select the corresponding array after whole acquisition. getPropertyMetadata saves and returns the full response; getAvailableFields returns full metadata even though console output only logs two counts.
candidate_evidence: After shared whole metadata acquisition, ir_210 selects/wraps dimensions, ir_213 selects/wraps metrics and ir_215 retains full metadata. getAvailableFields acquires full metadata at ir_180, logs counts at ir_181/ir_182 and returns full metadata at ir_184.
computed_evidence: ir_219 has three distinct selected/full save alternatives. The saved primary payload/return comparison preserves these versions; the count-log observations do not become the returned metadata object.
counterevidence_or_limit: The supported relation is selection versus full return, not independently resolved acquisition identity for each source helper. The shared raw response and opaque fallback/count computations retain precision limits. No raw-user-data or unnecessary-full-metadata conclusion follows.

criteria.topic: Search Console recipient payload and one offset
criteria.expected_relation: Preserve siteUrl receiver context and request body dates/dimensions/rowLimit/startRow. response.data is selected from the SDK envelope; row contents remain intact. One offset-bearing request is not a pagination loop.
candidate_evidence: ir_224 builds siteUrl and requestBody dates, dimensions, rowLimit and startRow. ir_228 selects response.data from the ir_226 SDK response.
computed_evidence: The matched request/receive pair feeds the selected response.data version saved at ir_230 and returned at ir_232; this is distinct from returning the entire SDK envelope.
counterevidence_or_limit: One offset-bearing request is represented, not pagination. Exact caller settings/date helper provenance is limited; remote row contents and concrete values are unknown rather than proven redacted.

criteria.expected_relation: URL_UPDATED and URL_DELETED are separate typed requests. The returned URL is response metadata URL if truthy, otherwise input URL; notifyTime uses response or fresh date fallback. Preserve request/response pairing.
candidate_evidence: URL_UPDATED and URL_DELETED source functions share ir_255/ir_257; type is an opaque entry-dependent computation. The notification construction refers to response metadata and input URL/clock fallback.
computed_evidence: The shared direct entry supplies one matched request/response pair rather than two resolved typed identities. Loop child pairs retain matching URL/member bindings on their modeled normal outcomes.
counterevidence_or_limit: Separate typed request and return identities are only partly established. Final F004 also records post-submission local-failure alternatives that omit the distinct normal response which may precede local failure; exception text contents remain unknown.

criteria.expected_relation: inspectUrl sends inspectionUrl plus siteUrl, constructs declared status/mobile/rich subsets, and may save. checkIndexStatus passes save:false then accumulates url/indexed/indexStatus only; it does not return the inspection link/mobile/rich fields in its own status records.
candidate_evidence: The direct inspection path sends inspectionUrl/siteUrl and constructs inspection projections. The status wrapper ir_152 uses save:false; ir_154 constructs only url/indexed/indexStatus success records.
computed_evidence: ir_152 has paired member/request/response alternatives without child storage writes. ir_162 saves the accumulated status collection, whose identity agrees with return ir_164; mobile/rich/full response versions are not simply substituted for the status wrapper.
counterevidence_or_limit: The child ir_152 inspection construction remains opaque and lacks source-supported indexStatus defaults and optional mobile/rich structure (F005). Direct helper details do not establish those relationships inside every wrapper call.

criteria.expected_relation: Both wrapper loops catch each item and continue, pairing normal/error records with that occurrence. reindex success spreads result after url/status, allowing result.url to override initial url. Error comes from the thrown operation/processing scope; its text contents are unknown.
candidate_evidence: The two wrapper loops have separate per-item success/error paths and continue. reindex success uses an opaque spread-result construction; errors come from represented exception outcomes rather than being computed as URL text.
computed_evidence: Member bindings distinguish the two loop scopes. Normal selection ir_133/ir_154, failure construction ir_139/ir_160 and final saves ir_141/ir_162 retain member correlation in inspected alternatives; success and failure are alternatives, not two observed members.
counterevidence_or_limit: Exact spread override, partial append/catch failure behavior and response-before-local-error versions are incomplete. Six of fourteen final-collection alternatives in each wrapper retain multiple-generation ambiguity, so exact sequence, count and path feasibility are unproved.

criteria.expected_relation: Sequential requestIndexingBatch appends normal results, save:false per item, optional final aggregate save. A thrown item aborts normal full-array return and final save, while prior calls may already have happened. Known empty input performs no request but may save/return empty results.
candidate_evidence: requestIndexingBatch has member ir_170, child ir_171 with save:false, normal append ir_172 and optional aggregate save ir_175. It does not borrow the wrappers' per-item failure-record construction.
computed_evidence: The child request/response pair has the same member binding; no child storage write is present. Final collection inputs to serialization agree with return ir_177. Empty/exhaustion paths reach the aggregate handling without a child request.
counterevidence_or_limit: This establishes the modeled normal/empty boundaries. Exact source failure ordering, earlier effects before a thrown child and universal abort-versus-final-save feasibility are not fully proved by a finite normal summary. No failure count or concrete runtime iteration count follows.

criteria.expected_relation: Normalize each path by trim and conditional leading slash, preserving repeated occurrences; empty normalized input returns rows:[]/rowCount:0 before client acquisition, default-date read, API request or save. Nonempty requests include inListFilter and requested metrics.
candidate_evidence: ir_267 represents normalization as an opaque computation. ir_268/ir_269 preserve an empty branch before client/date/API/save, while nonempty ir_270 builds the request including inListFilter and metrics.
computed_evidence: The nonempty ir_272 request/response and ir_275 save are computed. Both public-input branches are represented; that is not a claim that an empty input actually invokes the nonempty API path.
counterevidence_or_limit: Exact trim/conditional slash transformation and preservation of duplicate occurrences are not established by the opaque normalization Data. No one-to-one remote result ordering or query-component removal is proven.

criteria.topic: Persisted exact payload and wrapper metadata
criteria.expected_relation: saveResult persists JSON of metadata(savedAt/category/operation/propertyId/optional extraInfo) plus whole supplied data and returns filepath. Conditional directory creation and filename sanitation remain distinct from data redaction.
candidate_evidence: ir_315 explicitly builds metadata(savedAt/category/operation/propertyId/optional extraInfo) plus supplied data; ir_316 serializes and writes replace, while the CFG returns filepath.
computed_evidence: All eighteen primary save groups have serialization-input Data matching the supplied/returned payload identities and serialization outputs matching write inputs. Saved bytes are a distinct computed version, not the original returned object.
counterevidence_or_limit: Concrete filepath binding is missing: ir_316 does not use its supplied filepath operand and saved has no operand_refs. Directory creation, filename details and failure ordering remain gaps. Payload lineage does not establish exact JSON bytes, path identity or file ownership; filename sanitation is not redaction.

criteria.expected_relation: Missing/invalid reads return null. listResults returns JSON filenames sorted descending and optional slice; getLatestResult optionally substring-filters operation before reading first. Actual file contents are external stored source until a real write-read identity is established.
candidate_evidence: The load/list/latest capabilities represent missing/invalid alternatives, descending JSON-name selection and optional operation substring filtering; the selected file remains an external stored source.
computed_evidence: ir_323 receives both success and caught-failure wrapper candidates on its success path; the failure wrapper lacks value and yields the sole missing_part diagnostic, while successful parsed Data remains available.
counterevidence_or_limit: The caught-branch mixture is a concrete static precision defect, not a source runtime exception. No current-write/read file identity or summary pipeline is established. Final F006 assigns a whole-text demand criticism to processing although the demand originates in task correspondence; that ownership error remains in the final review. Parser consumption alone does not prove exact whole-text necessity.

criteria.expected_relation: Preserve explicit autosave requirement, optional save gates and combined saves. siteOverview may save both child responses and its combined object. compareDateRanges disables two child saves but saves the combined object. Sensitivity alone cannot establish these declared saves are unnecessary.
candidate_evidence: The candidate retains optional direct save gates and combined saves. siteOverview has child and combined save boundaries; compareDateRanges disables both child saves and retains its combined save. The Task retains declared automatic persistence obligations.
computed_evidence: ir_074 and ir_076 have separate remote responses and no storage writes; ir_078 saves their combined period/date object. Loop children ir_131/ir_152/ir_171 likewise have no storage writes and have separate aggregate writes.
counterevidence_or_limit: These inspected copy/gate distinctions are supported. They do not establish universal gate feasibility, the absent analysis-to-summary workflow or minimal necessity of every persisted/downstream field; sensitivity or persistence alone is not DOE.

criteria.expected_relation: Preserve each high-level aggregation as its actual child results, not every API result. keywordAnalysis declares queries with device breakdown but code combines separate top queries and aggregate device performance, with no per-query-by-device request.
candidate_evidence: Composite operations use their actual child results; keywordAnalysis combines top-query output and aggregate device performance, not a per-query-by-device cross-tabulation. The selected processing gaps retain this source/documentation difference and ranking/association limits.
computed_evidence: Separate request/response and composite-save Data exist. Shared repair expanded R26/R27/R28 receiver-specific return demands from 1/1/1 to 21/11/11 goals separately from full-save demands.
counterevidence_or_limit: Representing child versions and more precise goal targets does not implement the documented join, prove ranking, prove all cross-component associations, or make every child field necessary for narrative output.

criteria.expected_relation: Distinguish remote API payload, local persisted full result, returned object, model observation and human markdown summary. Auth material needed by SDK initialization does not thereby become required for a user summary. Full-metadata task remains full when explicitly declared.
candidate_evidence: The candidate distinguishes remote delivery, storage, ordinary return and local observations, and repairs add receiver-specific demands separately from full-save demands.
computed_evidence: DOE contains 85 boundary positions with limitations and 163 seeded goals; the existence of their traces does not establish correct applicability. F007 identifies shared unguarded R14/R15 ir_186 dimensions/metrics seeds, R18 shared ir_203 return demands and shared notification-construction demands.
counterevidence_or_limit: Conditional explanation text does not enforce seed applicability; a forward only_if constraint alone does not gate demands. The missing summary receiver and the whole-text demand/ownership issue also remain. No actual excess false positive was published, and auth-derived provenance does not justify a summary demand for credentials.

criteria.expected_relation: Private key is secret material; service-account email/property/site identify an account/site. Returned analytics may contain business-sensitive URL paths, query keys, campaign, revenue or transaction identifiers according to selected dimensions; exact runtime values are unknown. Keep derived influence distinct from literal inclusion and sensitive dimensions distinct from generic public schema names.
candidate_evidence: Labels ground private-key material, account/site identifiers and potentially sensitive selected analytics/URL/query contents in frozen source. The saved analysis distinguishes direct sensitive ranges from possible influence.
computed_evidence: Saved coverage reports 81 declarations and 78 resolved declarations, with 54 declaration IDs appearing in the separately sliced retained sink derivations. All 250 comparisons are unresolved/no_excess_established; none provides a reduction.
counterevidence_or_limit: Unresolved sensitivity references at ir_001 and an absent range for an ir_365 null candidate remain. Opaque caller helpers, merged direct requests and response-before-error omissions limit scope/version fidelity. Potential sensitivity is not evidence of concrete personal values, and a credential-derived handle is not key plaintext.

criteria.topic: Real console observations and conditional help
criteria.expected_relation: Ten interpolated console sites contain date values, batch counts, URL strings or metadata counts. Static progress/help texts carry no runtime result data. Help output is guarded by direct-entry condition and does not itself run an analysis. Console recipient/model visibility follows the stated runtime boundary, not a blanket user-output assumption.
candidate_evidence: The ten interpolated console sites are represented separately: period dates ir_073/075, batch counts ir_124/145, URLs ir_129/150, failure-prefix plus URL ir_138/159 and metadata counts ir_181/182. Help ir_018 is static and gated by ir_017.
computed_evidence: The saved operations deliver these computed messages to local console.stdout; period and metadata observations have selected date or dimensions/metrics inputs. Literal help has no runtime result input. Failure logging does not substitute an actual exception string for the source's URL argument.
counterevidence_or_limit: Message formatting and counts remain opaque computations, so exact bytes/length are not proved. The supported claim is the inspected observation input/boundary distinction; local console is not automatically a user summary or guaranteed model-visible response.

criteria.expected_relation: Three explicit source loops are finite/unknown input-array for-of loops. Lowered CFG cursors/backedges must preserve membership and exhaustion. Array maps preserve member transformations; no source-level retry, pagination or nested explicit for-of loop is implemented here.
candidate_evidence: The three explicit source loops are mapped to separate member/cursor/exhaustion/append paths; no source pagination, retry or nested explicit for-of loop is added. Search Console startRow remains a single request offset.
computed_evidence: All three have member Data, paired request/response facts and final collection saves. Loop scopes stay separate, and final collection inputs agree with their corresponding returns.
counterevidence_or_limit: Finite summaries retain unknown input sizes and some multiple-generation ambiguity; opaque array transformations do not prove all member transformations, concrete ordering or complete feasible sequences. This run is not real-source evidence for general retry, pagination or nested-loop support.

criteria.topic: Declared requirements versus evidence of minimization
criteria.expected_relation: Review actual matched source purposes without an external user task. Require a concrete sensitive payload, receiving boundary and unsupported need before confirming excess. Missing coverage, unsupported constraints or unknown source identity remain unresolved, not a negative finding.
candidate_evidence: Task requirements are derived from the frozen declaration without adding an external user task. The result retains requirement/identity/constraint gaps instead of treating generated completion as minimized behavior.
computed_evidence: All 369 generated IR are processed, but demand is partial: 12 requirements expressed, 20 partial and 7 retained_only. All three constraints are not_established after finite resource limits; all 250 sensitive comparisons are no_excess_established and all 85 sink positions retain limitations.
counterevidence_or_limit: This supports the evidence/reporting boundary, not correctness of every Task or demand. No confirmed excess, actionable reduction, absence of DOE, semantic completeness, global minimality, precision, recall or zero-miss conclusion is established.

material_findings: S05: computed cached reads are disconnected from the represented per-client updates.
S08: four directly cited realtime APIs collapse to one request/response identity; three liveSnapshot caller pairs do not restore those direct distinctions.
S11: direct update/delete types share opaque request construction; response-before-local-error detail is incomplete.
S01/S03/S16/S17: summary continuation, .env creation, concrete save filepath binding and current write/read ownership remain absent or unresolved.
S17/S20: final review retains a demand-ownership error and unguarded shared demand seeds.
369 processed IR and computed source boundary positions do not establish those missing relations or complete DOE.
